name: listingdoctor
description: Checks Amazon listings against Amazon's current rules (75-character titles since July 2026, Item Highlights, bullets, 249-byte backend search terms, forbidden characters and claims) and EU law (EmpCo eco claims, GPSR, textile labelling). Score plus the top 5 fixes per listing, from a category listing report, flat file, ASINs or pasted text. Runs locally, never changes your listings.
